mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (0.09%) is at a historically low level, indicating an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the rank correlation between UNRATE and 20-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) indicates a monetary tightening cycle that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.1%, or the rank correlation between the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) and 20-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the accommodative policy environment supports equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In the monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real personal consumption (RSAFS > 500000 million dollars) indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 500000, or the rank correlation between RSAFS and 60-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production level (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the rank correlation between INDPRO and 5-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 140000 and UNRATE < 6.0%) indicates robust consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000 AND UNRATE < 6.0%, or the rank correlation between the interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) and 60-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1500 thousand units) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or the rank correlation between HOUST and 5-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 5-year rolling window.
